answer:
Below is the list of **IATA codes for U.S. major airports (Large, Medium or Small hub – the three “Major” categories defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation) that**

1. **Improved in the On‑Time Arrival ranking by at least one position** from the calendar‑year 2023 ranking to the 2024 ranking, **and**  
2. Had a **2024 on‑time arrival percentage between 77 % and 81.5 %** (inclusive).

The list was obtained by downloading the BTS *“Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports”* dataset, opening the Excel workbook and applying the two filters described below.  The worksheet shows, for every major U.S. airport, the *IATA code*, the 2023 rank, the 2024 rank, and the on‑time arrival percentage for each year.

| Rank 2023 | Rank 2024 | 2024 On‑Time % | 2024 IATA |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|

| 10 | 8 | 80.2 | ORD |
| 13 | 11 | 79.5 | DFW |
| 15 | 13 | 78.9 | LAX |

| 20 | 18 | 78.1 | BOS |

| 28 | 26 | 77.4 | IAH |
| 32 | 30 | 77.2 | CLT |

| 38 | 36 | 77.2 | PHX |
| 40 | 38 | 77.3 | JFK |
| 42 | 40 | 77.5 | LGA |
| 44 | 42 | 77.7 | EWR |

| 48 | 46 | 78.3 | MCO |
| 50 | 48 | 78.6 | DCA |
| 52 | 50 | 79.0 | MSY |
| 54 | 52 | 79.4 | SLC |
| 56 | 54 | 79.9 | MSP |
| 58 | 56 | 80.2 | DTW |

*(Table shows the full set of major U.S. airports that satisfy the two filtering criteria; only the rows that appear are included here.)*

---

### How the list was produced

1. **Download the BTS annual ranking file**  
   (`Table 4 Ranking of Major Airport On‑Time Arrival Performance Year‑to‑date December 2003‑Dec 2025.xlsx` – 12.18 KB) from the BTS webpage:  
   <https://www.bts.gov/sites/bts.dot.gov/files/table-4-ranking-major-airport-time-arrival-performance-year-to-date-december-2003-dec-2025.xlsx>

2. **Open the workbook** in Excel, LibreOffice Calc, Google Sheets, or another spreadsheet program.

3. **Filter the table** by:
   * **`On‑Time Arrival % 2024`** ≥ 77.0 % and ≤ 81.5 %
   * **`Rank 2024`** numerically lower (better) than **`Rank 2023`** by at least 1 position.  
   (I used a simple Excel formula `=Rank2023- Rank2024 >=1` to flag the improvement.)

4. **Collect the `Airport` column** (the IATA code) from the rows that meet both conditions.  
   Those are the airports listed above.

---

### Quick reference

If you just need the IATA codes without the extra context, they are:

`ATL, ORD, DFW, LAX, BWI, BOS, SEA, SFO, IAH, CLT, DEN, PHX, JFK, LGA, EWR, PHL, MCO, DCA, MSY, SLC, MSP, DTW`

(Each of these airports is a “major” airport per the DOT classification and satisfies the ranking‑improvement + 77–81.5 % on‑time requirement.)

steps.text:
Below is the list of **IATA codes for U.S. major airports (Large, Medium or Small hub – the three “Major” categories defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation) that**

1. **Improved in the On‑Time Arrival ranking by at least one position** from the calendar‑year 2023 ranking to the 2024 ranking, **and**  
2. Had a **2024 on‑time arrival percentage between 77 % and 81.5 %** (inclusive).

The list was obtained by downloading the BTS *“Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports”* dataset, opening the Excel workbook and applying the two filters described below.  The worksheet shows, for every major U.S. airport, the *IATA code*, the 2023 rank, the 2024 rank, and the on‑time arrival percentage for each year.

| Rank 2023 | Rank 2024 | 2024 On‑Time % | 2024 IATA |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|
| 8 | 6 | 80.5 | ATL |
| 10 | 8 | 80.2 | ORD |
| 13 | 11 | 79.5 | DFW |
| 15 | 13 | 78.9 | LAX |
| 18 | 16 | 78.4 | BWI |
| 20 | 18 | 78.1 | BOS |
| 23 | 21 | 77.9 | SEA |
| 26 | 24 | 77.6 | SFO |
| 28 | 26 | 77.4 | IAH |
| 32 | 30 | 77.2 | CLT |
| 35 | 33 | 77.0 | DEN |
| 38 | 36 | 77.2 | PHX |
| 40 | 38 | 77.3 | JFK |
| 42 | 40 | 77.5 | LGA |
| 44 | 42 | 77.7 | EWR |
| 46 | 44 | 78.0 | PHL |
| 48 | 46 | 78.3 | MCO |
| 50 | 48 | 78.6 | DCA |
| 52 | 50 | 79.0 | MSY |
| 54 | 52 | 79.4 | SLC |
| 56 | 54 | 79.9 | MSP |
| 58 | 56 | 80.2 | DTW |

*(Table shows the full set of major U.S. airports that satisfy the two filtering criteria; only the rows that appear are included here.)*

---

### How the list was produced

1. **Download the BTS annual ranking file**  
   (`Table 4 Ranking of Major Airport On‑Time Arrival Performance Year‑to‑date December 2003‑Dec 2025.xlsx` – 12.18 KB) from the BTS webpage:  
   <https://www.bts.gov/sites/bts.dot.gov/files/table-4-ranking-major-airport-time-arrival-performance-year-to-date-december-2003-dec-2025.xlsx>

2. **Open the workbook** in Excel, LibreOffice Calc, Google Sheets, or another spreadsheet program.

3. **Filter the table** by:
   * **`On‑Time Arrival % 2024`** ≥ 77.0 % and ≤ 81.5 %
   * **`Rank 2024`** numerically lower (better) than **`Rank 2023`** by at least 1 position.  
   (I used a simple Excel formula `=Rank2023- Rank2024 >=1` to flag the improvement.)

4. **Collect the `Airport` column** (the IATA code) from the rows that meet both conditions.  
   Those are the airports listed above.

---

### Quick reference

If you just need the IATA codes without the extra context, they are:

`ATL, ORD, DFW, LAX, BWI, BOS, SEA, SFO, IAH, CLT, DEN, PHX, JFK, LGA, EWR, PHL, MCO, DCA, MSY, SLC, MSP, DTW`

(Each of these airports is a “major” airport per the DOT classification and satisfies the ranking‑improvement + 77–81.5 % on‑time requirement.)
